summary: Build practical ESG governance, materiality, and reporting skills in 5 days. Learn with GRI, ISSB, and COSO ERM.
lede: An environmental, social and governance program connects sustainability priorities with business goals, oversight, and evidence-based reporting. This course is for professionals working in ESG, governance, reporting, risk, or operations who need to turn fragmented activity into a structured approach. It develops practical skills in materiality assessment, ESG risk mapping, governance design, metric selection, and preparing a board-ready reporting pack.
audienceIntro: This course is for professionals who already sit close to ESG, governance, reporting, risk, or operations and need a more structured way to connect strategy with evidence.
prerequisites: You need a laptop, spreadsheet access, and a working understanding of corporate sustainability, reporting, compliance, risk, or governance processes. If available, bring any current ESG report, materiality assessment, policy set, or scorecard from your organization for use in exercises.
